name: Manatua submarine cable - Alofi cable landing facility
developer: Manatua Cable Consortium (OPT, Avaroa Cable, Telecom Niue, SSCC) / SubCom supplier
notes: Manatua is Niue's only fibre connectivity asset (first fibre link; 3,634 km, 2 fibre pairs, Samoa-Niue-Cook Islands-French Polynesia; consortium includes Telecom Niue per SubCom contract-in-force PDF). Government of Niue media release (2026-08-07) confirms the cable is in service and suffered a fault offshore Samoa on 2026-08-04, with repairs coordinated by Manatua Cable partners and monitoring by Government of Niue and Telecom Niue. Landing station near BCN Transmission Tower at Seikena (Alofi area) per TV Niue. Telecom cable station, NOT a datacenter/colo - no facility-access/RIO/interconnect service published.

name: Telecom Niue core network and government network services (incl. Alofi/Tuapa network sites)
developer: Telecom Niue Ltd (Government of Niue 100% SOE)
notes: Telecom Niue is the sole local fixed/mobile/internet operator (government-owned since 2016 corporatisation). Gov.nu 2026 release confirms ongoing island-wide fibre-optic network upgrades, two new network sites being deployed in Alofi and Tuapa, and continued repeater rollout; Telecom Niue also acts as project manager for government departments migrating to the new network. Operator/network lead (telecom_network_lead), NOT a datacenter - no public colocation/rack/data-centre service page verified.

name: Starlink (SpaceX) temporary licensed connectivity service
notes: Government of Niue approved a temporary 12-month Spectrum and Internet Communications Licence to Starlink (SpaceX) on 2026-05-12 after regulatory/compliance clearance, enabling a defined trial period complementing Telecom Niue. Connectivity/resilience service (connectivity_service), NOT a datacenter. Earlier unlicensed-use reporting must be time-scoped.

name: Niue Renewable Energy Phase 1 - Hikufenoga PV/BESS (power context, near airport)
developer: Government of Niue / Department of Utilities; Sunergise (EPC); MFAT-funded
notes: Gov.nu project page: Niue Renewable Energy Phase 1 at Hikufenoga, Tamakautoga (near airport), 2.79 MWp PV + 8.19 MWh BESS + grid upgrade, target completion July 2026, toward 80% renewable target; handover to Department of Utilities/Niue Power Corporation. Energy context only (power_context) - NOT datacenter evidence; supports load plausibility checks for any large server load on the island grid.

name: .NU ccTLD / IUSN DNS registry infrastructure
developer: The IUSN Foundation (manager); The Internet Infrastructure Foundation / Internetstiftelsen (technical)
notes: IANA delegation record (updated 2025-07-03): ccTLD manager The IUSN Foundation (Alofi), technical contact and name-server infrastructure in Sweden (Internet Infrastructure Foundation). DNS/registry context (dns_registry_context), NOT local datacenter evidence - do not count .nu/DNS/Wi-Fi-nation story as DC.

name: Public cloud regions in Niue (AWS/Azure/GCP/Oracle OCI) - verified negative
notes: Verified negative: no AWS Region/Local Zone, Azure region, Google Cloud region or OCI region in Niue per official provider pages (re-checked 2026-08-12). No hyperscale capacity. Recheck official region pages on each refresh.

name: Commercial colocation / datacenter market in Niue - verified negative (no_market)
notes: No public neutral colocation, tiered datacenter, cloud hosting or dedicated-server facility in Niue; Telecom Niue offers no public colo/rack/hosting page. Overseas 'Niue VPS / Alofi dedicated server / Niue cloud hosting' SEO pages are false positives (no local address/operator anchoring) - not counted. Tui-Samoa/SSCC/Apia references are Samoa-context, not Niue landings.
